scope: One accepted seed only on fixed validation texts. Root checked complete coverage/receipt work, source/protocol/result/raw-file hashes, every saved-stage loss mean, identical same-fit weight hashes and control summaries. Existing independent verifier recomputed raw-logit losses and exact control bits across all batches. Resource comparison with independent T4096 root is work/control parity only, not a paired quality contrast. No generalization, numerical BF16 equivalence, physical-device, energy or hardware-latency claim. Main treatment remains one logical p-bit per parameter; software simulator counters and programming/range metadata are additional costs.
